# PCW Contracting Services

> Southern California general contractor serving homeowner associations, commercial properties, and other building types since 1989. California contractor license #699611.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://callmat3ai-cloud.github.io/pcw-feedback-review-2026/): Home: commercial and HOA reconstruction services, completed projects, testimonials, and contact.
- [About](https://callmat3ai-cloud.github.io/pcw-feedback-review-2026/about/): About: company background, licensing, and the reasons clients choose PCW.
- [Contact](https://callmat3ai-cloud.github.io/pcw-feedback-review-2026/contact/): Contact: request an estimate and reach the Costa Mesa office.
- [Employment](https://callmat3ai-cloud.github.io/pcw-feedback-review-2026/employment/): Employment: send a resume by email to Customerservice@pcwservices.com.
- [Testimonials](https://callmat3ai-cloud.github.io/pcw-feedback-review-2026/testimonials/): Client testimonials from community managers, board members, and property owners.
- [Project Services](https://callmat3ai-cloud.github.io/pcw-feedback-review-2026/project-services/): Project services for large-scale reconstruction and building envelope repair.
- [Property Services](https://callmat3ai-cloud.github.io/pcw-feedback-review-2026/property-services/): Property services for individual repairs and ongoing maintenance.
- [Our Work](https://callmat3ai-cloud.github.io/pcw-feedback-review-2026/our-work/): Portfolio of PCW work and project listings.
- [Knowledge Hub](https://callmat3ai-cloud.github.io/pcw-feedback-review-2026/knowledge-hub/): Knowledge hub index with three approved construction guides.

## Approved guides
- [El Nino Prep](https://callmat3ai-cloud.github.io/pcw-feedback-review-2026/knowledge-hub/el-nino-prep/): Preparing a property and office for storm-season work orders.
- [Surviving El Nino](https://callmat3ai-cloud.github.io/pcw-feedback-review-2026/knowledge-hub/surviving-el-nino/): Managing inspections, tarps, and communication during storm season.
- [What A Vendor Needs](https://callmat3ai-cloud.github.io/pcw-feedback-review-2026/knowledge-hub/what-a-vendor-needs/): Information to provide a vendor before emergency repair work.
